description: This file defines a StringCodec class responsible for serializing and deserializing string objects within the Orleans.Serialization framework. It includes methods for reading and writing string data, handling raw data, multi-segment reads, and reference management.

classes.name: StringCodec
classes.description: A serializer class for encoding and decoding strings in Orleans serialization framework.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a string value from the specified reader, handling reference and length-prefixed wire types.

methods.name: ReadRaw
methods.description: Reads raw string content based on the byte length, either directly or using multi-segment reading.

methods.name: ReadMultiSegment
methods.description: Handles reading string data across multiple memory segments when it cannot be read contiguously.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a string field, writing reference information or length-prefixed UTF-8 data.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Writes a string field without type information, optimized for expected static types.

methods.name: WriteRaw
methods.description: Encodes the string into the buffer as UTF-8, handling both small and large data efficiently.

methods.name: WriteMultiSegment
methods.description: Handles encoding of strings that span multiple memory segments.
